thesis: Review-only 결론은 WATCH다. 핵심 사업의 고객가치·해자·혁신성은 강하지만, $741.25에서 price/Base 1.161x로 기대차가 작고 AI 인프라의 증분 ROIC·FCF/share 회복이 아직 검증되지 않았다. Hard Veto는 모두 해소됐지만 compounder·growth·outlier_growth·buffett_value·moonshot 어느 유형도 실행 조건을 충족하지 못한다. 현재 상태는 '비싸지만 지속기간이 과소평가됨'보다 '상당한 장기 성장이 이미 가격에 반영됨'에 가깝다.

evidence.claim: The deterministic aggregate scores META at 65.65/100 (67.0 ex-valuation), but every investable archetype has one or more failed conditions; primary state is non_fit.
At $741.25, locked Bear/Base/Bull values are about $267/$638/$1,091 and price/Base is 1.1611x; valuation is below Bull but above Base.

RF is 59 with incremental_roic 50 and fcf_per_share_quality 50 because unprecedented AI investment absorbs very large cash resources while maintenance-versus-growth capex and realized incremental NOPAT remain unresolved.
After domain reviewers and Red Team review, the aggregate Hard Veto status is CLEARED with no confirmed, unresolved or pending vetoes.

ED identifies primary-source coverage as generally strong but flags concentrated reuse of AI ad-monetization evidence and the unobserved incremental return on AI infrastructure as the central evidence gap.

The macro overlay applies a 0.5 risk-budget and purchase-pacing multiplier because credit remains orderly but monetary and geopolitical conditions are restrictive/high-risk; fundamental company score effect is zero.

counterevidence: Customer/product score 75 and moat trajectory 78.5 show the core advertising/network franchise remains strong.
Disruptive innovation score 73.5 reflects measured AI ad gains, Business Agent adoption and AI-glasses traction.
Financial survival score 70 and cleared vetoes make a solvency-driven permanent loss thesis weak.
Bull value remains materially above the current price, so a strong AI monetization outcome can still create upside.
unknowns: The realized incremental ROIC on the 2025-26 AI infrastructure step-up remains unobserved.
A decision-useful maintenance-versus-growth split of long-run AI capex is unavailable.
The long-run margin and profit contribution of Business Agent, paid messaging and AI wearables are not yet disclosed.
falsifiers: Owner FCF/share fails to recover above the 2025 level by 2028 despite continued double-digit revenue growth.
Ad pricing and impressions turn persistently negative together or AI conversion lifts fail to repeat.
AI infrastructure commitments keep rising without measurable incremental profit/FCF, confirming a structurally lower-return capital model.

key_kpis.name: Incremental AI return evidence
key_kpis.threshold: observable profit/FCF bridge sufficient to lift incremental_roic above current 50 score

key_kpis.name: Price / Base value
key_kpis.direction: fall via price or rise via fundamentals
key_kpis.threshold: <=1.10x for growth gate; stronger margin for other value-sensitive archetypes

next_checks: Re-run after Q3/FY2026 capex, OCF, FCF/share and 2027 infrastructure guidance.
Reassess market misperception and asymmetry if Base/Bull values change or price moves materially.
Track whether messaging/agents/wearables become material independent profit pools rather than optionality narratives.

uncertainties.rationale: No investable archetype currently satisfies all deterministic gates, so review-only IC cannot authorize a new buy.
The largest capital-allocation program lacks a directly observable realized return bridge.
Price is above Base and market_misperception/upside-path scores remain below outlier-growth requirements.

plain_language.business: Meta는 Facebook·Instagram·WhatsApp 같은 대규모 서비스에서 광고와 메시징으로 돈을 번다. AI는 추천과 광고 효율을 높이고 새 에이전트·웨어러블 사업으로 확장되는 중이다.
plain_language.opportunity: 사용자 규모와 광고 네트워크는 강하고, AI가 광고 성과를 더 높이거나 메시징·웨어러블이 새 이익원이 되면 장기 가치가 커질 수 있다.
plain_language.risk: 문제는 AI 인프라에 투입되는 돈이 매우 커졌는데 그 추가 투자수익률이 아직 명확히 증명되지 않았다는 점이다. 현재 주가도 하네스의 Base 가치보다 높아 실행 실수에 대한 여유가 크지 않다.
plain_language.decision_reason: Hard Veto는 없지만 어떤 투자 유형의 필수 조건도 모두 통과하지 못했다. 그래서 현재는 신규 매수보다 관찰이 맞고, FCF/share 회복과 AI 투자수익이 확인되거나 가격 대비 가치 여유가 커질 때 다시 평가한다.
